Run11 provider usage evidence supplied by the owner: Codex 126/126 token_count events satisfy total_tokens == input_tokens + output_tokens and reasoning_output_tokens <= output_tokens (e.g. output 94, reasoning 15); Claude Code 4577/4577 usage records have output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens <= output_tokens. tools/agent_session_stats.py stores both counters side by side and notes reasoning is not added to output. Claude and Codex cover 93% of 1528194 calls. Generated tokens are output_per_call alone (mean 511.9); reasoning_per_call (about 207.5) is an informational subset, not an additional decode or API charge. Muse is treated the same way, unverified. Fraction 1 is only the explicitly labelled reasoning-on-top upper bound reproducing the old accounting; it is not a provider billing claim. Joint depth/new-token fitting and random draws are unchanged.
